answer: Under the crystal, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. Standing rots without use: identities must re-validate with new graded work every few epochs or lose their earning rate. Under the delta, a clone army is a maintenance burden — every fake needs feeding with fresh work, and the farm's upkeep bill grows with the size of its herd. Through the jetty, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
